description:
Here's a description of the provided plot, following the guidelines:

The plot illustrates the relationship between TFLOPs and Loss Ratio for several configurations of SepLLM. The x-axis is labeled “TFLOPs” and uses a linear scale, ranging from 1e7 to 9e8, with tick labels at intervals of 1e7. The y-axis is labeled “Loss Ratio (%)” and uses a linear scale, ranging from 94 to 100, with tick labels at intervals of 1. There are five lines displayed. The first, colored orange, is labeled “SepLLM (n=64)” and begins at approximately 97.2 at 1e7 TFLOPs, rises to a peak of 99.8 at 2e8 TFLOPs, and then declines to 99.3 at 9e8 TFLOPs. The second, colored blue, is labeled “SepLLM (n=128)” and starts at approximately 97.1 at 1e7 TFLOPs, rises to a peak of 99.7 at 2e8 TFLOPs, and then declines to 99.1 at 9e8 TFLOPs. The third, colored green, is labeled “SepLLM (n=64, H)” and begins at approximately 97.3 at 1e7 TFLOPs, rises to a peak of 99.9 at 2e8 TFLOPs, and then declines to 99.4 at 9e8 TFLOPs. The fourth, colored red, is labeled “SepLLM (n=64, H/T)” and starts at approximately 94.1 at 1e7 TFLOPs, rises to a peak of 99.8 at 2e8 TFLOPs, and then declines to 99.3 at 9e8 TFLOPs. All lines are solid and do not include markers.
